data.summary: The spark directory contains configuration settings for Apache Spark to integrate with Apache Iceberg and S3-compatible storage such as MinIO.

file_insights.name: spark-defaults.conf
file_insights.summary: Configuration file for Apache Spark and Apache Iceberg integration.
file_insights.source_summary: Sets Spark properties for Iceberg extensions, default catalog, catalog type, URI, I/O implementation, S3 endpoint, path-style access, and region.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains Spark configuration parameters for integrating Apache Spark with Apache Iceberg, defining catalog settings, S3 storage integration via MinIO, and Iceberg REST catalog URI.
responsibilities: Set up Iceberg REST catalog URI and type
Configure S3 file IO and MinIO endpoint for object storage
